subject.title: chore(env): config-surface reduction tranche 4 — env-var cleanup (review request)

question: Should OpenClaw formally retire the undocumented environment aliases and test/build controls in this tranche, including the loss of `OPENCLAW_CONFIG` compatibility, after current-main upgrade proof?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the externally observable environment contract rather than repairing an established runtime bug; repository policy treats config and fallback removal as compatibility-sensitive and the PR is explicitly marked for maintainer review.

options.title: Approve the documented cutoff after upgrade proof
options.body: Rebase onto current main and attach redacted terminal evidence that documented variables work while the retired aliases no longer influence normal production execution.

options.title: Retain a temporary migration path
options.body: Keep a narrowly documented compatibility or Doctor-assisted path if maintainers determine that a removed alias has a shipped operator contract that needs a transition window.

recommendation.title: Approve the documented cutoff after upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main and attach redacted terminal evidence that documented variables work while the retired aliases no longer influence normal production execution.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active reduction program and previously landed the adjacent merged tranches.
